instruction: A candid wedding photograph in a medium shot captures a romantic moment indoors. Against a white wall with floral arrangements, the groom in the dark suit (R1) stands on the left in profile, extending his arms forward with his hands hovering near the shoulders of the bride in the strapless white gown (R2). The bride stands on the right, holding a pastel bouquet and looking up at him with a soft smile. Her sheer veil drapes elegantly behind her. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the scene, creating a clean, romantic atmosphere with neutral tones.

R2 is the bride being approached by R1's outstretched hands
R2 looks up at R1 with a soft smile
the scene is indoors against a white wall with floral arrangements
